Depends on the Adventures of Galthen Quest; each addon is a boss fight (≈15–30 min)

The {wiki:Ancient Aucar Outfits|Ancient Aucar Outfits} (also called *Iks Outfit*) are obtained in the lost city of {wiki:Iksupan}, in Tiquanda, during the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest}. The base outfit comes from the idol that the boss {creature:Ahau} drops the first time; the first addon is earned by fighting Ahau again wearing the Broken Iks equipment; the second addon comes from the boss {creature:Mitmah Vanguard}.
Secret passage to Iksupan (Tiquanda, near Port Hope)
**Outfit and addon 1:** access to the boss {creature:Ahau}, in the mission *Galthen and the City of Gold* of the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest}.
**Addon 2:** having completed the mission *Galthen and the City of Gold Part II* of the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest}.
You don't need the {item:Broken Iks Spear} or the {item:Broken Macuahuitl}
Base {wiki:Ancient Aucar Outfits|Ancient Aucar Outfit} (with {item:The Living Idol of Tukh})
Spherical teleport to the Iksupan Last Stand
After defeating Ahau, when you accept the help of {npc:Ahau's Dead Chamberlain} ({key:yes}).
Keep the Broken Iks pieces you loot in Iksupan: you need all 4 (head, chest, legs and feet) for the first addon.
Each player who wants addon 1 must have their own Broken Iks set equipped during the fight.

{wiki:Iksupan} lies beneath **Tiquanda**, the jungle around **Port Hope**. Take a boat to Port Hope (for example, with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}) and cross the jungle to the ruins where the Writ of the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest} is. Use {item:The Key Intihuatac} (obtained in that quest) on the inscriptions: the secret passage takes you into the city of gold.

Once inside, find the way to the **third floor** and keep heading **north**. You pass through a lava area with stones you can walk on until you reach a room with **two blue flames**. The **north** flame leads to the lever room, where you start the fight (up to **5 players**).
On the third floor there is walkable lava that takes health **proportional to your maximum health**. Don't move by map-click and pay attention to the path.

Complete the mission *Galthen and the City of Gold* of the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest}, defeating the boss {creature:Ahau} in {wiki:Iksupan}. The first time you kill him, you loot {item:The Living Idol of Tukh}.

Along the way and in the fight you face {creature:Iks Aucar|Iks Aucars}, {creature:Iks Chuka|Iks Chukas}, {creature:Iks Pututu|Iks Pututus}, {creature:Cursed Ape|Cursed Apes}, {creature:Iks Ahpututu|Iks Ahpututus} and {creature:Iks Churrascan|Iks Churrascans}.
Use {item:The Living Idol of Tukh} to receive the outfit.

To leave, use the shortcut just **east** of the blue flames: the {item:Slab with a Skull} teleports you back to the entrance, in the Tiquanda ruins. From there, go back through the jungle to **Port Hope**, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat.

Get the 4 pieces: {item:Broken Iks Headpiece}, {item:Broken Iks Cuirass}, {item:Broken Iks Faulds} and {item:Broken Iks Sandals}. The {item:Broken Iks Spear} and the {item:Broken Macuahuitl} are **not** needed.

Go back to {creature:Ahau}'s room the same way as in section 1 (secret passage in Tiquanda, third floor, north blue flame) — you have to kill him again, even if you have done it before. **Before** you pull the lever, put on the 4 Broken Iks pieces and keep them equipped throughout the fight.
Only those wearing the set during the fight receive the addon and the title. The Broken Iks pieces are destroyed in the process.

Exactly **2 minutes** after the fight starts you receive the addon message. If the boss dies before then, stay in the room and wait for the message: *"A challenger worthy of the aucar warrior attire would now bear the right to carry a macuahuitl as well."*
Leave as in section 1: the {item:Slab with a Skull}, just **east** of the blue flames, teleports you back to the Iksupan entrance.

After defeating Ahau, talk to the ghost {npc:Ahau's Dead Chamberlain}, outside Ahau's lever room, and accept his help with {key:yes}. You can now use the {wiki:Spheric Teleporter|spheric teleporter} in that room, which takes you near the underground city. Follow the corridor, go up the stairs to a tomb with an opening to the **east** and go down the hole: you arrive at {wiki:Iksupan Last Stand}. The rest of the way to the boss is part of the mission *Galthen and the City of Gold Part II* (trap corridor and the four Mitmah keys).
With the **first addon** of this outfit, the spike trap counter on the way north starts at **99** instead of **3**.
Complete the mission *Galthen and the City of Gold Part II* of the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest} and defeat the boss {creature:Mitmah Vanguard}.
To leave, go back the same way to Ahau's area and use the {item:Slab with a Skull}, **east** of the blue flames, to be teleported to the Iksupan entrance, in Tiquanda.
Also known as the **Iks Outfit Quest**.
Broken Iks pieces used up on addon 1 cannot be reused by other players.
